title: Sex Biased Collecting Strategy for Gene Expression in Mealybugs
author: Laura Ross
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.nkndcve

steps.title: Prepare Mated Females
steps.instruction: Separate mated females that are about to lay eggs on sprouted potatoes or sprouted beans and wait until the first eggs are laid.

steps.title: Collect and Fix Embryos
steps.instruction: Collect embryos every 24 hours as they are laid and fix them using Carnoy fixative.

substeps.instruction: Place embryos in 200-500 uL Carnoy fixative (4 parts chloroform, 3 parts ethanol, 1 part acetic acid) in a 1.5mL Eppendorf tube.
Store at 4ºC for a maximum of 4 days.
If embryos must be prepared after 4 days, replace the fixative with 90-100% ethanol and store at 4ºC.

steps.title: Prepare Slides for Staining
steps.instruction: Transfer embryos to a microscope slide and prepare for DAPI staining.

substeps.instruction: Transfer embryos to a microscope slide.
Allow fixation or ethanol to evaporate until the slide is dry but the embryo remains humid.

steps.title: Stain Embryos with DAPI
steps.instruction: Apply DAPI stain and seal the slides.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 uL of DAPI diluted in 1xPBS at 1:1000.
Add a coverslip and seal with nail polish.
Keep in the dark for 10-15 min.

steps.title: Visualize and Identify Embryos
steps.instruction: Use a fluorescence compound microscope to determine the sex of the embryos.

substeps.instruction: Visualize slides with a fluorescence compound microscope (heterochromatin is best seen at 200x).
For each slide (containing all embryos from one day of oviposition), identify and count the number of male and female embryos.

steps.title: Analyze Sex Ratio Data
steps.instruction: Document and graph the sex ratios of the collected embryos.

substeps.instruction: Report the sex ratio for each day of oviposition.
Repeat the process for at least 5 females if possible.
Use Excel or R to create a graph of the sex ratio.
